title: installment.payment_recorded (CORE_BANKING)
description: One event = one row of installments_payments.csv (original column names and values are kept in payload). event_time: Submission date + DAYS_ENTRY_PAYMENT (DAYS_INSTALMENT if missing), during business hours.

event_id.description: BLAKE2b-128 of source_table + natural key. Deterministic -> use it for de-duplication.

schema_version.description: SemVer. A MAJOR change -> new topic (.v2).

event_time.description: Business time (simulated, +07:00). Submission date + DAYS_ENTRY_PAYMENT (DAYS_INSTALMENT if missing), during business hours.

produced_at.description: Wall-clock time the producer sent the event.

customer_id.description: SK_ID_CURR of the customer; also the Kafka message key.

SK_ID_CURR.description: ID of loan in our sample

NUM_INSTALMENT_VERSION.description: Version of installment calendar (0 is for credit card) of previous credit. Change of installment version from month to month signifies that some parameter of payment calendar has changed

NUM_INSTALMENT_NUMBER.description: On which installment we observe payment

DAYS_INSTALMENT.description: When the installment of previous credit was supposed to be paid (relative to application date of current loan)
DAYS_INSTALMENT.x-note: time only relative to the application

DAYS_ENTRY_PAYMENT.description: When was the installments of previous credit paid actually (relative to application date of current loan)
DAYS_ENTRY_PAYMENT.x-note: time only relative to the application

AMT_INSTALMENT.description: What was the prescribed installment amount of previous credit on this installment

AMT_PAYMENT.description: What the client actually paid on previous credit on this installment
